$comment: One entry per lemma. `pos` selects which inflection fields are meaningful. `forms` is the authoritative surface-form map used for auto-resolution of unannotated words; keys are form names, values are the Norwegian surface strings.

datter.note: Feminine nouns take either -en or -a in the definite singular. 'dattera' is the everyday spoken form; 'datteren' is equally correct.

voksen.gloss: adult, grown-up (in barnehage context: staff member)

klær.note: Plural only — there is no singular form in use.

henge opp.note: Separable verb: the particle 'opp' detaches in main clauses.

på grunn av.note: Fixed prepositional phrase; always three words.

mene.gloss: to mean, to be of the opinion

for det første.note: Discourse marker for ordering arguments; pairs with 'for det andre'.

gå ut på.gloss: to be about, to consist of

ha lyst til.gloss: to feel like, to want to

egg.note: Irregular: unchanged in the indefinite plural.

avtale.note: Definite singular is avtalen, not avtaleen.

sko.note: Irregular: unchanged in the indefinite plural.

passe.gloss: to fit, to suit; to mind

lei seg.note: Fixed expression: «å være lei seg». Does not inflect.

tre (substantiv).note: Irregular plural: trær. Distinct from the numeral «tre» (three).

dyr (substantiv).note: Unchanged in the indefinite plural. Distinct from the adjective «dyr» (expensive).

$idComment: Every entry carries a stable `id` (<lemma>-<pos>). Annotations and SRS state should reference the id, not the lemma string: lemmas get renamed and can collide across parts of speech, ids do not.
